hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in ""|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/build/*|*/node_modules/*|*.svg) exit 0;; esac; [ -x node_modules/.bin/dprint ] || exit 0; [ -f "$f" ] && npx dprint fmt "$f" 2>&1; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/build/*|*/node_modules/*) exit 0;; esac; [ -x node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2 ] || exit 0; if [ -f "$f" ]; then out=$(npx markdownlint-cli2 "$f" 2>&1); [ $? -ne 0 ] && { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in ""|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/build/*|*/node_modules/*|*.svg) exit 0;; esac; [ -x node_modules/.bin/cspell ] || exit 0; if [ -f "$f" ]; then out=$(npx cspell lint --no-progress "$f" 2>&1); [ $? -ne 0 ] && { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; true

[ -f "source/[[ product_name ]].slnx" ] || exit 0; command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(dotnet build "source/[[ product_name ]].slnx" --configuration Release 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi
